headlines.text: On this day in 2025, Adam Page vs. Kyle Fletcher met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 8.67 ? an outstanding performance from both sides. Page hit a Buckshot Lariat off the apron to defeat Fletcher after a grueling half-hour semifinal, advancing to face Ospreay at Double or Nothing.
It was 2025 when it was a long-awaited, welcome sight as Jay Lethal returned to the ring after 8 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
On this day in 2025, Kazuchika Okada was back in action after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2025, when Toni Storm vs. Miyu Yamashita met in an Eliminator Match on Dynamite, rated 6.64.
